name: Entra / Sign-ins of risky users
text:
riskyUsers
| where riskLevel in ({RiskLevel})
| join kind=inner (signIns | where createdDateTime > ago({Lookback})) on $left.id == $right.userId
| project createdDateTime, userDisplayName, userPrincipalName, appDisplayName, ipAddress, riskLevelDuringSignIn
| order by createdDateTime desc
